Same code as your other Pathfinder tools — enter it once anywhere and it applies everywhere on this device. Whoever knows the code can read/write this data.
Pathfinder 1e full Occult Adventures psychic spell list — reusable for any psychic, save each one under their own name. Psychics are spontaneous casters: they know a fixed number of spells (the “Known” toggle), then cast any known spell of a level using that level’s daily slot pool. Cantrips (0-level) are known the same way but cast at will, unlimited. Uses Intelligence for bonus spells and DCs; caster level equals psychic level. Their Psychic Discipline (granting bonus known spells and governing the phrenic pool) isn’t modeled here.
